meta.name: verification-before-completion
meta.description: Use when about to claim work is complete, fixed, or passing, before committing or creating PRs - requires running verification commands and confirming output before making any success claims; evidence before assertions always

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在提交前强制运行验证命令并确认结果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果总是忘了在声称完成前先运行测试或验证
copy.tagline_en: Force running verification commands and confirming output before committing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often forget to run tests or verification before claiming work is complete

howto.what: 在你声称工作完成、通过或修复之前，它会强制先运行验证命令（如测试、构建），读取完整输出并确认通过后，才允许做出成功声明。它还会拒绝使用“应该”“可能”等模糊表述。
howto.when: 当你或它即将做出任何完成、成功、满意的声明，或提交代码、创建PR、完成任务、移步下一任务时触发。

say.text: 在提交之前，运行所有测试并告诉我结果。
say.note: 它必须运行测试命令并展示输出，不能跳过。

say.text: 验证构建是否通过，然后才能说完成。
say.note: 它会执行构建命令并检查退出码。

say.text: 用检查清单确认所有需求都满足，出示证据。
say.note: 它逐项验证并报告结果。

howto.what_en: Before claiming work is complete, fixed, or passing, it forces running verification commands (e.g., tests, build), reading full output, and confirming pass before allowing any success claim. It also rejects vague words like 'should' or 'probably'.
howto.when_en: Triggers whenever you or it is about to make any completion/success/satisfaction claim, commit, create PR, finish task, move to next task, or delegate to agents.

say_en.text: Run all tests and report results before committing.
say_en.note: It must execute the test command and show output.

say_en.text: Verify the build passes and then claim done.
say_en.note: It runs the build command and checks exit code.

say_en.text: Go through the checklist and confirm all requirements with evidence.
say_en.note: It checks each item and reports actual status.
